text_en: Then all Israel gathered together to David at Hebron and said, “See, we are your bone and flesh.
text_cn: 那时，全以色列人聚集到赫贝龙，来见达味说：“看，我们都是你的骨肉。

text_en: For some time now, even while Saul was king, it was you who commanded the army of Israel. The Lord your God said to you: It is you who shall be shepherd of my people Israel, you who shall be ruler over my people Israel. ”
text_cn: 以前连撒乌耳为王时，也是你率领以色列出入征讨；并且上主你的天主，也曾对你说过：你应牧养我的百姓以色列，作我的百姓以色列的领袖。”

text_en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord . And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
text_cn: 以色列所有的长老都到赫贝龙来见君王，达味就在赫贝龙，在上主面前同他们立了约；他们便按照上主藉撒慕尔所吩咐的，给达味傅油，立他为以色列王。

text_en: David and all Israel marched to Jerusalem, that is Jebus, where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
text_cn: 达味和全以色列人便向耶路撒冷，即耶步斯进发，当时住在那地方的是耶步斯人。

text_en: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here. ” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion, now the city of David.
text_cn: 耶步斯的居民对达味说：“你决攻不进此地。”但是，达味却占领了熙雍山堡，即今达味城。

text_en: David had said, “Whoever attacks the Jebusites first shall be chief and commander. ” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, so he became chief.
text_cn: 达味曾说过：“谁首先击败耶步斯人，谁将升为将领和元帅。”责鲁雅的儿子约阿布首先上去了，所以他成了元帅。

text_en: David resided in the stronghold; therefore it was called the city of David.
text_cn: 达味便住在那山堡内，因此人称之为达味城。

text_en: He built the city all around, from the Millo in complete circuit; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
text_cn: 达味又重修四周城垣，从米罗起，重修一周；城的其余部分由约阿布修建。

text_en: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord of hosts was with him.
text_cn: 达味日渐强盛，万军的上主与他同在。

text_en: Now these are the chiefs of David’s warriors, who gave him strong support in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
text_cn: 以下这些人，是极力拥护达味建国，与全以色列人照上主对以色列所吩咐的，立他为王的主要将士。

text_en: This is an account of David’s mighty warriors: Jashobeam, son of Hachmoni, was chief of the Three; he wielded his spear against three hundred whom he killed at one time.
text_cn: 达味的将士名单如下： 哈革摩尼的儿子依市巴耳，是三杰之首；一次他曾举起长矛，击杀了三百人。

text_en: And next to him among the three warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo, the Ahohite.
text_cn: 次为阿曷亚人多多的儿子厄肋阿匝尔，三杰之一，

text_en: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines were gathered there for battle. There was a plot of ground full of barley. Now the people had fled from the Philistines,
text_cn: 他以前同达味在帕斯达明，培肋舍特人正在那里集合准备交战时，【以色列人退却，他却固守阵地，击杀培肋舍特人，直到他手软无力，贴在刀柄上。上主在那一天完成了一大胜利；民众返回，随着他去抢战利品。再其次是哈辣黎人厄拉的儿子沙玛，那时培肋舍特人在肋希集合】，在那里有一块长满大麦的田地，民众由培肋舍特人面前逃走，

text_en: but he and David took their stand in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great victory.
text_cn: 他却立在田间保护了那块田地，杀败了培肋舍特人，如此上主又完成了一次大胜利。

text_en: Three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David at the cave of Adullam, while the army of Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
text_cn: 一次三十勇士中，有三位下到阿杜蓝山砦（zhài）附近的岩石里去见达味，那时培肋舍特人正扎营在勒法因平原里，

text_en: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then at Bethlehem.
text_cn: 同时达味恰在山砦内，培肋舍特人当时也在白冷驻防，

text_en: David said longingly, “O that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem that is by the gate! ”
text_cn: 达味渴望说：“谁能从白冷城门旁的井中，给我打一点水来喝？”

text_en: Then the Three broke through the camp of the Philistines, and drew water from the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, and they brought it to David. But David would not drink of it; he poured it out to the Lord ,
text_cn: 那三位勇士就冲过培肋舍特人的营幕，从白冷城门旁的井中打了水，将水取来带到达味前；但达味不肯喝，反而将水奠于上主前，

text_en: and said, “My God forbid that I should do this. Can I drink the blood of these men? For at the risk of their lives they brought it. ” Therefore he would not drink it. The three warriors did these things.
text_cn: 说：“我的天主决不许我做这事！我岂能喝这些冒生命危险者的血？因为这是他们冒生命危险取来的。”所以他不肯喝。这是这三个勇士所做的。

text_en: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Thirty. With his spear he fought against three hundred and killed them, and won a name beside the Three.
text_cn: 约阿布的兄弟阿彼瑟，是三十勇士的领袖，他挥舞长矛杀了三百人，因此在三十勇士中出了名；

text_en: He was the most renowned of the Thirty, and became their commander; but he did not attain to the Three.
text_cn: 他在三十勇士中享有双重的名望，做了他们的领袖，但尚不及三杰。

text_en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a valiant man of Kabzeel, a doer of great deeds; he struck down two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in a pit on a day when snow had fallen.
text_cn: 约雅达的儿子贝纳雅原是卡贝责耳人，是一位英勇大有作为的人，曾击杀摩阿布人阿黎耳的两个儿子；又在下雪天，下到旱井里打死了一只狮子。

text_en: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits tall. The Egyptian had in his hand a spear like a weaver’s beam; but Benaiah went against him with a staff, snatched the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
text_cn: 他也曾打死了一个埃及巨人。这埃及人身高五肘，手中拿着粗如织布机轴的长矛，贝纳雅下去，手中仅拿着一根棍杖，从那埃及人手中，把长矛夺了过来，用那长矛将他杀死。

text_en: Such were the things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did, and he won a name beside the three warriors.
text_cn: 这是约雅达的儿子贝纳雅所做的事。因此在三十勇士中出了名。

text_en: He was renowned among the Thirty, but he did not attain to the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
text_cn: 他比三十勇士更有名望，但尚不及三杰。达味派他作侍卫长。

text_en: The warriors of the armies were Asahel brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
text_cn: 其余的勇士：有约阿布的兄弟阿撒耳，白冷人多多的儿子厄耳哈难，

text_en: Shammoth of Harod, Helez the Pelonite,
text_cn: 哈洛得人沙摩特，帕耳提人赫肋兹，

text_en: Ira son of Ikkesh of Tekoa, Abiezer of Anathoth,
text_cn: 特科亚人依刻士的儿子依辣，阿纳托特人阿彼厄则尔，

text_en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
text_cn: 胡沙人息贝开，阿曷亚人依来，

text_en: Maharai of Netophah, Heled son of Baanah of Netophah,
text_cn: 乃托法人玛哈赖，乃托法人巴阿纳的儿子赫肋得，

text_en: Ithai son of Ribai of Gibeah of the Benjaminites, Benaiah of Pirathon,
text_cn: 本雅明族基贝亚人黎拜的儿子依泰、丕辣通人贝纳雅，

text_en: Hurai of the wadis of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
text_cn: 加阿士溪人胡赖，贝特阿辣巴人阿彼巴耳，

text_en: Azmaveth of Baharum, Eliahba of Shaalbon,
text_cn: 巴胡陵人阿次玛委特，沙阿耳宾人厄里雅巴，

text_en: Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,
text_cn: 基宗人雅笙，哈辣黎人沙革的儿子约纳堂，

text_en: Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
text_cn: 哈辣黎人撒加尔的儿子阿希杨，乌尔的儿子厄里法耳，

text_en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
text_cn: 默革辣人赫费尔，基罗人阿希雅，

text_en: Hezro of Carmel, Naarai son of Ezbai,
text_cn: 加尔默耳人赫兹赖，厄次拜的儿子纳阿赖，

text_en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,
text_cn: 纳堂的兄弟约厄耳，哈革黎的儿子米贝哈尔，

text_en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai of Beeroth, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
text_cn: 阿孟人责肋克，贝厄洛特人纳赫赖，他是责鲁雅的儿子约阿布的执戟者，

text_en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
text_cn: 雅提尔人依辣，雅提尔人加勒布，

text_en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
text_cn: 赫特人乌黎雅，阿赫来的儿子匝巴得，

text_en: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, a leader of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
text_cn: 勒乌本人史匝的儿子阿狄纳，他是勒乌本人的首领，有三十个人跟随他，

text_en: Hanan son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
text_cn: 玛阿加的儿子哈南，默腾人约沙法特，

text_en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
text_cn: 阿市塔洛特人乌齐雅，阿洛厄尔人曷堂的儿子沙玛和耶厄耳，

text_en: Jediael son of Shimri, and his brother Joha the Tizite,
text_cn: 提漆人史默黎的儿子耶狄阿耳和他的兄弟约哈，

text_en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
text_cn: 玛红人厄里耳，厄耳纳罕的儿子耶黎拜和约沙委雅，摩阿布人依特玛，

text_en: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
text_cn: 厄里耳，敖贝得和祚巴人雅息耳。
